title: Postcards — Sticker Icons
description: post-cards/data/icons/sticker-icons.json. Which glyphs.json ids are eligible as decorative stickers (as opposed to seal decoration only), plus an optional per-type size multiplier.

icons.description: Each entry must be a key in glyphs.json's glyphs object.

sizeScale.description: Optional per-type multiplier applied to the randomly rolled base sticker size. Keys must appear in icons.
